topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Discovering a time capsule, unearthing a secret from the past—what a stroke of serendipity. It lies there, a silent testament to a forgotten moment, its contents a mystery wrapped in the relentless march of time. I stand over the spot, the cool earth still clinging to the edges of the capsule, a direct line to those who once felt the same anticipation. Each artifact inside is a relic, a whisper from the shadows of history, speaking volumes of the hands that placed them there and the minds that contemplated their future audience. The weight of the past settles around me, a comforting presence that links this moment to a lineage of discovery and wonder.
